answer_1.quote: we conducted an experiment in which we modified a dataset of task-based referring expressions, systematically varied the referring forms shown to participants, allowing us to collect naturalness ratings for all possible referring forms that could have been used in those referring expressions.
answer_1.outputs: referring forms (e.g., it, this, that, the-N', N')

answer_4.quote: we performed an online experiment in which participants watched a series of videos from a dataset of human-human task based interactions. After each video, the participant was shown, in text, the next utterance spoken in the video, and asked to evaluate its naturalness.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to rate its naturalness on a 5-point Likert item, with 1 being very unnatural and 5 being very natural.
